title: Decent knife set, a little pricey for the quality though
text: Decent knife set, a little pricey for the quality though. This should be priced at about $50 in my opinion so the quality matches the price. The knives work well enough and get the job done, just not super impressed with them. At $50, I wouldn't have complained though.
